# Gosub

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Functions](Language-Features-Functions)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Gosub label
```

## Description

Runs the code at `.label` like a subroutine. The code has to end with [Return](Return), which comes back to the line after the `Gosub`. The label has to be in the same function or in the main program, depending on where the `Gosub` is.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Gosub greet
Gosub greet
End

.greet
Print "hello"
Return
```

```text
hello
hello
```
